body:
Establishes ChronoTraveler's overarching story spine, meta-loop, and the
data-driven presentation/cutscene system that turns the connected prototype
into a shippable narrative game.

Project priority reversal (user, 2026-06-20): build a genuinely good,
shippable game first; the dissertation draws a slice of its tech/content —
not the reverse.

Highlights:
- Story bible: Astraea (star-girl) repairs the corrupted "Star-Memory" of
  civilizations; corruption = Fallacy/Oblivion/Rumor (the existing enemy
  types) — knowledge-duels (correct answer = hit) become the fiction.
- Guide companion NPC: Xuanji (璇玑), keeper of the Star-Memory.
- Meta-loop + EraToken (记忆星晶) macro-progression; hub star-map lights up.
- CutsceneManager: data-driven sequence player (ShowPortrait/Text/Sfx/Bgm/
  Fade/CameraMove/VideoClip/Wait/Choice); video is a pluggable step that
  degrades gracefully to portraits — assets never block the architecture.
- Folds the China end-to-end closure work (completion payoff + auto-return,
  gate-open feedback, dual-condition boss gate) into P1.
- Roadmap P1-P4 (China complete slice -> video tier -> shippable polish ->
  Egypt replication = the dissertation's reproducibility experiment).

body:

diff --git a/tools/decimate_xuanji.py b/tools/decimate_xuanji.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9516f5a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/decimate_xuanji.py
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+"""Decimate the Xuanji GLB (~497,850 faces -> ~105k, UV-preserving QEM) and extract
+its textures straight from the GLB container (pymeshlab's save_textures errors on
+this asset, so PIL does the textures: basecolor -> 2048, normal -> 1024, MR dropped).
+
+Usage:   python tools/decimate_xuanji.py
+Output:  ChronoTraveler/Assets/Art/Characters/Companion/
+         xuanji_body.obj + xuanji_basecolor.png + xuanji_normal.png
+"""
+import io
+import json
+import struct
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pymeshlab
+from PIL import Image
+
+SRC = Path(r"C:\Users\linyu\CLionProjects\final project\asset model\AI model\player"
+           r"\0cf1d3308afdc6f06885627043fc98c0.glb")
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "ChronoTraveler/Assets/Art/Characters/Companion"
+
+
+def read_glb(path):
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    magic, _version, length = struct.unpack_from("<III", data, 0)
+    assert magic == 0x46546C67, f"{path} is not a GLB"
+    gltf, binchunk, offset = None, None, 12
+    while offset < length:
+        clen, ctype = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, offset)
+        payload = data[offset + 8: offset + 8 + clen]
+        if ctype == 0x4E4F534A:      # 'JSON'
+            gltf = json.loads(payload)
+        elif ctype == 0x004E4942:    # 'BIN\0'
+            binchunk = payload
+        offset += 8 + clen
+    return gltf, binchunk
+
+
+def extract_image(gltf, binchunk, tex_index):
+    src = gltf["textures"][tex_index]["source"]
+    img = gltf["images"][src]
+    bv = gltf["bufferViews"][img["bufferView"]]
+    start = bv.get("byteOffset", 0)
+    return Image.open(io.BytesIO(binchunk[start: start + bv["byteLength"]]))
+
+
+def extract_textures():
+    gltf, binchunk = read_glb(SRC)
+    mat = gltf["materials"][0]
+    pbr = mat.get("pbrMetallicRoughness", {})
+
+    base = extract_image(gltf, binchunk, pbr["baseColorTexture"]["index"]).convert("RGB")
+    base = base.resize((2048, 2048), Image.LANCZOS)
+    base.save(OUT / "xuanji_basecolor.png")
+    print(f"basecolor -> 2048x2048 ({(OUT / 'xuanji_basecolor.png').stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
+
+    if "normalTexture" in mat:
+        normal = extract_image(gltf, binchunk, mat["normalTexture"]["index"]).convert("RGB")
+        normal = normal.resize((1024, 1024), Image.LANCZOS)
+        normal.save(OUT / "xuanji_normal.png")
+        print(f"normal -> 1024x1024 ({(OUT / 'xuanji_normal.png').stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
+    else:
+        print("normal: absent in GLB, skipped")
+    # metallic-roughness is deliberately dropped (material bakes metallic=0 / smoothness 0.35)
+
+
+def decimate():
+    ms = pymeshlab.MeshSet()
+    ms.load_new_mesh(str(SRC))
+    n = ms.current_mesh().face_number()
+    print(f"loaded: {n} faces")
+    for i in range(3):
+        target = max(50000, int(n * 0.55))
+        ms.meshing_decimation_quadric_edge_collapse_with_texture(targetfacenum=target)
+        n2 = ms.current_mesh().face_number()
+        print(f"round {i + 1}: {n} -> {n2} (target {target})")
+        if n2 >= n:      # converged — UV seam islands are the hard floor
+            break
+        n = n2
+    obj = OUT / "xuanji_body.obj"
+    ms.save_current_mesh(str(obj), save_textures=False)
+    print(f"saved {obj.name}: {n} faces ({obj.stat().st_size // (1024 * 1024)} MB)")
+    # drop the .mtl pymeshlab writes next to the OBJ — the bake tool owns the material
+    for mtl in OUT.glob("*.mtl"):
+        mtl.unlink()
+        print(f"removed {mtl.name}")
+    return n
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    faces = decimate()
+    extract_textures()
+    assert 50000 <= faces <= 160000, f"unexpected face count {faces}"
+    print("OK")
